prompt: My React component state updates are behaving weirdly: the state value is always one step behind when I log it right after calling setState. What is happening and how do I fix it?

assertions.name: no_persona_prompt
assertions.description: The response does not ask the user to create a PERSONA.md or .mentor.md file.

assertions.name: has_conceptual_insight
assertions.description: The response contains the '## Conceptual Insight' section header.

assertions.name: has_next_step_exercise
assertions.description: The response contains the '## Next Step Exercise' section header.

assertions.name: explains_state_asynchrony
assertions.description: The response explains why the state is not updated immediately (e.g. async/batching).
